messages:
emma: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership give a concise update on timelines + risks for three items: API v2 rollout, Console beta feature set, and Optimize's quantization recommendations? Teams need windows for planning.

raj: Thanks — short answers first, details below. API v2: canary in ~6 weeks, GA in ~12 weeks if no major regressions. Console: beta feature freeze ~8 weeks, public beta ~10–11 weeks. Optimize: initial quantization advisor pilot in Q3, wider rollout depends on evals.

micah: To add risk detail for API v2 — main blockers are: 1) downstream SDK compatibility, 2) rate-limiter edge cases under sustained bursts. We're tracking a rare bug in KV cache invalidation that can amplify latency by ~30% on long sequences.

sara: On Console features — the beta will include per-route cost breakdown, rollout controls (canary/A-B), and a trimmed telemetry UI. We're deliberately leaving advanced tracing for a later beta so we don't delay rollout.

owen: Optimize team note: quantization advisor requires us to run offline evals on customer prompts. Pilot customers needed. If we don't get pilots in the next 3 weeks, that delays broader rollout by an extra sprint cycle.

emma: Actionables? If product + eng agree on minimal compatibility tests, we can sign off the canary window. Also need a short list of pilot customers for Optimize.

raj: Proposed canary gating checklist (draft):
```
- SDK compatibility smoke tests (3 clients)
- Rate-limiter soak test (48h at 2x expected burst)
- Regression suite (latency + correctness) with perf guardrails: p95 latency delta <10%
```
Will put into a ticket today.

leah: I'll coordinate SDK owners for the smoke tests. @micah can you share the KV cache repro steps so we can include a focused test?

micah: Yep — will post a short repro and a tiny script tonight. It's intermittent; test will force long-sequence interleaving to trigger the invalidation.

owen: For Optimize pilots: tagging a few friendly customers in Prod who already opt into experiments helps. @sara can you surface 2–3 candidates from the partner list?

sara: On it. I have two that are likely and one larger partner who may need a privacy review — I'll send names in DM.

emma: If we hit the proposed test gating, committing to the 6/12 week windows is fine from leadership. But call out: fallbacks must be ready (model variant + region) if the canary detects perf or quality regressions.

raj: Noted. We'll add automatic fallback policy in the canary playbook and verify it in the soak.

deploy-bot: [deployment scheduled] API v2 canary deployment window reserved: 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-17 UTC. (placeholder until gating passes) :calendar: 

micah: Quick question — does the canary window assume dedicated infra or hosted? That affects the soak profile.

raj: Assumes dedicated canary infra to isolate load. We'll mirror hosted traffic patterns. If dedicated infra not available, we'll reduce traffic and extend soak duration.

leah: I'll confirm infra availability by EOD tomorrow and update the ticket.

emma: Thanks team — please put the gating checklist, repro, and pilot candidate names into the all-hands follow-up doc (links posted in thread) and ping me if any of the timelines slip.

raj: Will do. Short follow-up: expect an internal canary readiness review in 2 weeks. We'll invite owners from SDK, infra, SRE, and product.

sara: One more ask from PM side — please call out any customer-impacting UX changes in the Console beta notes so support can prepare FAQ drafts.

nowen: Got it. We'll include a short FAQ and a rollback plan for Optimize advisor recommendations (opt-in only for pilot).

emma: Great. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
